summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FOMO AI Access panel bug fix (G27) in Spaceport → My NFT. Verified panel always renders (shows connect prompt when no wallet), uses GREEN styling (#04A584), displays 3 NFT cards correctly with dev wallet, activate action works, and memberships page regression passed.
passed_tests: Panel visibility without wallet - shows connect prompt with data-testid='nft-access-connect'
Panel heading 'FOMO AI Access' is present and visible
Dev wallet authentication via localStorage + cookie + query param works correctly
All 3 NFT token cards render with correct statuses: #100 (Benefit expired), #101 (Available), #102 (Active)
DEV/TEST tag displays correctly with data-testid='nft-access-devtag'
Effective access banner shows with data-testid='nft-access-effective'
Activate button for token #101 uses GREEN color rgb(4, 165, 132) = #04A584, NOT purple
Activate action successfully changes token #101 from Available to Active
Success toast appears after activation with data-testid='nft-access-toast'
Memberships page renders both FOMO AI and FOMO Intel cards without crashes
NFT alternative button in memberships page uses GREEN color (#04A584), NOT purple
